title: Posting job runs CBTRN02C against six datasets
rule: POSTTRAN has a single step (STEP15) that runs CBTRN02C, reading the daily transaction file and card cross-reference, updating the account master and transaction-category balances, writing posted transactions to the transaction master, and writing rejects to a new 430-byte generation of the daily rejects GDG.

test.given: a daily file with 4 valid transactions
test.then: TRANSACT holds 4 records, ACCTDATA and TCATBALF are updated, and DALYREJS(+1) is catalogued as an empty 430-byte dataset

title: Every daily record is read sequentially until end of file
rule: CBTRN02C reads DALYTRAN one record at a time; file status 00 means a record, 10 means end of file and stops the loop, and any other status displays 'ERROR READING DALYTRAN FILE' and abends. Each record read is counted as processed.

test.given: a DALYTRAN file with 2 records
test.then: WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT = 2 and the program ends normally after status 10

title: Validation order: card, then account, then limit and expiry
rule: Each transaction is validated in a fixed order: the card must exist in the cross-reference; only if it does is the account read and the credit-limit and expiry checks applied. A failed card lookup skips all account checks.

test.given: card 4000999999999999 is not in CARDXREF
test.then: the reason is 100 and the account file is not read for this record

title: Reject 100: card number not in cross-reference
rule: If DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM has no CARDXREF record, the transaction is rejected with reason 0100 and description 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'.

test.given: transaction 0000000000000002 with card 4000999999999999 and no matching CARDXREF record
test.then: a DALYREJS record is written with trailer '0100INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND' and nothing is posted for it

title: Reject 101: account in cross-reference but not on account master
rule: If the card's cross-referenced account id has no ACCTDATA record, the transaction is rejected with reason 0101 and description 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'; the limit and expiry checks are not applied.

test.given: card 4000000000001099 maps to account 00000001099, which is absent from ACCTDATA
test.then: the reject trailer is '0101ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' and RC is 4

title: Credit-limit check uses cycle amounts, not the current balance
rule: A transaction is over limit when ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT exceeds ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT. The account's current balance is not used. Landing exactly on the limit is accepted.

test.given: account 1003 with limit 1000.00, cycle credit 950.00, cycle debit 0.00
test.then: WS-TEMP-BAL = 1000.00, which is <= the limit, so the purchase posts

title: Reject 102: over-limit transaction
rule: When the cycle-based balance would exceed the credit limit, the transaction is rejected with reason 0102 and description 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.

test.given: account 1003 with limit 1000.00 whose cycle credit is already 1000.00
test.then: WS-TEMP-BAL = 1100.00 > 1000.00, the trailer is '0102OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' and the account is unchanged by it

title: Limit check sees earlier postings in the same run
rule: The account is re-read from the master for every transaction, and accepted postings rewrite it immediately, so the limit check for a later transaction includes amounts posted earlier in the same file.

test.given: account 1003, limit 1000.00, cycle credit 950.00; two purchases of 50.00 then 100.00
test.then: the first posts (cycle credit becomes 1000.00) and the second is rejected with 102 because 1000.00 + 100.00 > 1000.00

title: Reject 103: transaction after account expiry
rule: If the account expiry date is earlier than the first 10 characters (the date part) of the transaction's origin timestamp, the transaction is rejected with reason 0103 and description 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'. A transaction on the expiry date itself is accepted. The comparison is a plain character comparison of YYYY-MM-DD text.

test.given: account 1004 expiring 2022-01-31 and account 1005 expiring 2022-07-04; both transactions have origin 2022-07-04-09.15.00.000000
test.then: the account 1004 transaction is rejected with '0103TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'; the account 1005 one posts

title: Expiry reason overrides over-limit reason
rule: The limit and expiry checks are both applied, one after the other, without stopping at the first failure. If a transaction is both over limit and after expiry, the reject carries only reason 0103 and the expiry text.

test.given: an account with limit 100.00, cycle credit 90.00, expiry 2022-01-31
test.when: a 50.00 purchase with origin 2022-07-04 is validated
test.then: one reject is written with trailer '0103TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION' (reason 102 is overwritten)

title: Blank or zero expiry date rejects every transaction
rule: Because expiry is compared as text, an expiry date of spaces or '0000-00-00' sorts below any real origin date, so every transaction for that account is rejected with reason 103.

test.given: an account whose ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is '0000-00-00'
test.when: a transaction with origin 2022-07-04 is validated
test.then: it is rejected with reason 0103

title: Reject record layout: input record plus 80-byte trailer
rule: A rejected transaction is written to DALYREJS as the unchanged 350-byte daily record followed by an 80-byte trailer: a 4-digit reason code and a 76-character description. A write failure displays 'ERROR WRITING TO REJECTS FILE' and abends.

test.given: a rejected transaction with reason 102
test.then: the record is 430 bytes: bytes 1-350 equal the input record, bytes 351-354 are '0102', bytes 355-430 are 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' padded with spaces

title: Rejects are counted and the posting continues
rule: A rejected transaction increments the reject count and processing continues with the next record; rejects never stop the run.

test.given: a file with one invalid-card record and one valid record
test.then: one record is rejected, the other is posted, and both are counted as processed

title: Return code 4 when any transaction is rejected
rule: CBTRN02C ends with return code 4 if at least one transaction was rejected, otherwise 0.

test.given: a run with 2 transactions of which 1 is rejected
test.then: STEP15 ends with RC 4 (RC 0 when no rejects)

title: Posting SYSOUT messages and counters
rule: CBTRN02C displays 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C', then at the end 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' and 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :' each followed by a 9-digit zero-padded count, then 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C'.

test.given: 2 transactions, 1 rejected
test.then: SYSOUT contains 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :000000002' and 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :000000001'

title: Posted transaction copies the daily record field by field
rule: An accepted daily transaction is written to the transaction master with id, type, category, source, description, amount, merchant id/name/city/zip, card number and origin timestamp copied unchanged from the daily record.
fields: TRAN-ID, TRAN-TYPE-CD, TRAN-CAT-CD, TRAN-SOURCE, TRAN-DESC, TRAN-AMT, TRAN-MERCHANT-ID, TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME, TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY, TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP, TRAN-CARD-NUM, TRAN-ORIG-TS (CVTRA05Y)

test.given: daily transaction 0000000000000001, type 01, category 0001, amount 125.00
test.then: TRANSACT has a record keyed 0000000000000001 with the same field values

title: Processing timestamp is the run clock, not the input value
rule: TRAN-PROC-TS is set from the current date and time in DB2 timestamp form YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000 (hundredths of a second followed by '0000'); the daily record's own DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is ignored.

test.given: the clock frozen at 2022-07-05 10:00:00.00

title: Transaction-category balance key
rule: Each posting updates the transaction-category balance identified by the cross-referenced account id, the transaction type code and the category code.

test.given: account 00000001006, type 02, category 0001
test.then: the TCATBALF key used is '00000001006020001'

title: Create a category balance record when none exists
rule: If no balance record exists for the key, CBTRN02C displays 'TCATBAL record not found for key : <key>.. Creating.' and writes a new record whose balance equals the transaction amount.

test.given: no TCATBALF record for account 1006, type 03, category 0001
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'TCATBAL record not found for key : 00000001006030001.. Creating.' and a new record with TRAN-CAT-BAL = -25.50 is written

title: Add to an existing category balance
rule: If the balance record exists, the transaction amount (positive or negative) is added to TRAN-CAT-BAL and the record is rewritten.

test.given: TCATBALF record 00000001003010001 with balance 950.00
test.then: the balance becomes 1000.00

title: Category balance read error abends
rule: Any TCATBALF read status other than 00 (found) or 23 (not found) displays 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION BALANCE FILE' and abends. Write and rewrite failures display 'ERROR WRITING TRANSACTION BALANCE FILE' or 'ERROR REWRITING TRANSACTION BALANCE FILE' and abend.

test.given: TCATBALF returns status 92 on read
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION BALANCE FILE', the file status line and 'ABENDING PROGRAM'

title: Account balance and cycle totals updated by sign of amount
rule: Every posted amount is added to the account's current balance. A zero or positive amount is also added to the cycle credit; a negative amount is added (as a negative number) to the cycle debit, so cycle debit grows more negative.

test.given: account 1006 with balance 800.00, cycle credit 800.00, cycle debit 0.00
test.then: balance = 534.50, cycle credit = 860.00, cycle debit = -325.50

title: Payments raise the limit-check amount
rule: Because cycle debit holds negative amounts and the limit check subtracts it, every payment or credit posted in the cycle increases the amount tested against the limit instead of lowering it.

test.given: an account with limit 1000.00, cycle credit 600.00 and cycle debit -500.00 (a 500.00 payment)
test.then: WS-TEMP-BAL = 600.00 - (-500.00) + 50.00 = 1150.00 > 1000.00 and the purchase is rejected with 102

title: Account rewrite failure sets reason 109 but is not a reject
rule: If the account rewrite fails with an invalid key, reason 109 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' is stored, but the record is neither counted as rejected nor written to DALYREJS, and the transaction is still written to TRANSACT.

test.given: an account deleted between its read and rewrite
test.then: the transaction is in TRANSACT, the reject count is unchanged and RC is not raised by it

title: Posting order: category balance, account, transaction
rule: For an accepted transaction the category balance is updated first, then the account, then the transaction record is written. A failure writing the transaction ('ERROR WRITING TO TRANSACTION FILE') abends after the balances were already changed.

test.given: a transaction whose id already exists in TRANSACT
test.then: TCATBALF and ACCTDATA are updated, then the duplicate-key write fails, SYSOUT shows 'ERROR WRITING TO TRANSACTION FILE' and the program abends

title: Transaction master is opened for output
rule: CBTRN02C opens the transaction master KSDS for OUTPUT, so the posted transactions of this run are the only content written by the program (the file is loaded from DALYTRAN.PS.INIT by the TRANFILE setup job, empty in every fixture).

test.given: an empty transaction master and 4 accepted transactions
test.then: TRANSACT contains exactly those 4 records in transaction-id order

title: Empty daily file posts nothing and ends RC 0
rule: If the daily file has no records, nothing is written to TRANSACT or DALYREJS, both counters are zero and the return code is 0.

test.given: an empty DALYTRAN
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :000000000' and 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :000000000'; RC 0

title: File open, close and I/O errors abend with a status line
rule: Any unexpected file status on open, read, write or close displays a specific message (for example 'ERROR OPENING DALYTRAN'), then 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' followed by the 4-digit status, then 'ABENDING PROGRAM', and calls CEE3ABD with abend code 999. Off-host the CEE3ABD stub returns RC 12.

test.given: the account master cannot be opened (status 35)
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'ERROR OPENING ACCOUNT MASTER FILE', 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0035', 'ABENDING PROGRAM' and the step ends with the abend

title: No rounding; amounts carry exactly two decimals
rule: All posting arithmetic is ADD or COMPUTE on fields with two decimal places, without ROUNDED and without ON SIZE ERROR. Results are exact; a value that exceeds the receiving field's integer digits loses its high-order digits silently.

test.given: a TCATBALF balance of 999,999,999.00
test.then: TRAN-CAT-BAL becomes 1.00 (high-order digit truncated) and no error is raised

title: Report step 1: unload the transaction master
rule: TRANREPT first copies the transaction master KSDS (in transaction-id order) to a new 350-byte sequential backup generation with IDCAMS REPRO.

test.given: a TRANSACT KSDS with 4 records
test.then: TRANSACT.BKUP(+1) holds the same 4 records

title: Report step 2: sort by card number and filter by processing date
rule: A SORT step keeps only transactions whose processing date (bytes 305-314) is between 2022-01-01 and 2022-07-06 inclusive, and sorts them ascending by card number (bytes 263-278). These dates are hard-coded in the JCL SYMNAMES, not read from DATEPARM. Records with equal card numbers keep their input (transaction-id) order.

test.given: transactions 1 and 3 on card ...1001 and 2 and 4 on card ...1002, all processed 2022-07-05
test.then: TRANSACT.DALY(+1) is in the order 1, 3, 2, 4

title: Report date range comes from the DATEPARM record
rule: CBTRN03C reads one DATEPARM record: start date in columns 1-10, end date in columns 12-21, and displays 'Reporting from <start> to <end>'. An empty DATEPARM sets end of file, so no transaction is reported.

test.given: DATEPARM contains '2022-01-01 2022-07-06'
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'Reporting from 2022-01-01 to 2022-07-06'

title: Out-of-range processing date ends the report loop
rule: CBTRN03C checks each record's processing date against the DATEPARM range. A record outside the range executes NEXT SENTENCE, which leaves the whole read loop: no further records are reported and no page or grand total is written.

test.given: an empty sorted transaction file (the record area stays blank, which is below the start date)
test.then: the loop exits at once: the report file has 0 lines and no 'TRAN-AMT' or 'WS-PAGE-TOTAL' lines appear in SYSOUT

title: Each reported transaction is echoed to SYSOUT
rule: For every in-range record CBTRN03C displays the raw 350-byte transaction record on SYSOUT before reporting it.

test.given: 4 sorted transactions
test.then: SYSOUT contains the 4 records verbatim, in sorted order

title: Report headers on the first detail and on each new page
rule: Before the first detail line the program fills the date range and writes four header lines: the report name line ('DALYREPT', 'Daily Transaction Report', 'Date Range: <start> to <end>'), a blank line, the column header line and a line of 133 dashes.

test.given: DATEPARM 2022-01-01 to 2022-07-06 and one transaction
test.then: line 1 starts 'DALYREPT' and ends 'Date Range: 2022-01-01 to 2022-07-06', line 2 is blank, line 4 is 133 '-' characters

title: Detail line format
rule: Each detail line holds transaction id (16), account id (11 digits from the cross-reference), type code '-' type description truncated to 15, category code (4 digits) '-' category description truncated to 29, source (10), and the amount edited as -ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ (leading '-' for negatives, blank for positives), padded to 133 bytes.
fields: TRAN-REPORT-TRANS-ID, TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID, TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-CD, TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC, TRAN-REPORT-CAT-CD, TRAN-REPORT-CAT-DESC, TRAN-REPORT-SOURCE, TRAN-REPORT-AMT (CVTRA07Y)

test.given: transaction 0000000000000003, account 1001, type 02 'Payment', category 0001 'Payment - Bank Transfer', source OPERATOR, amount -200.00
test.then: the line reads '0000000000000003 00000001001 02-Payment         0001-Payment - Bank Transfer       OPERATOR      -        200.00'

title: Zero amounts print as blanks
rule: The amount pictures use only Z for digit positions, so a 0.00 amount prints as all spaces on detail and total lines (standard COBOL editing).

test.given: a posted transaction with amount 0.00
test.then: the 15-character amount field on its detail line is blank

title: Lookups for report descriptions abend when missing
rule: On every card-number change the card is looked up in CARDXREF; for every record the type and type+category are looked up in TRANTYPE and TRANCATG. A missing key displays 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ', 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : ' or 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY : ' with the key, then 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0023' and abends.

test.given: a posted transaction with type 09 that is not in TRANTYPE
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : 09', 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0023', 'ABENDING PROGRAM'

title: Account totals break on card number
rule: When the card number differs from the previous record (and it is not the first record), an 'Account Total' line with the accumulated amount is written, followed by a dash line, and the account total is reset. The break is on card number, not account id.

test.given: card ...1001 with 125.00 and -200.00 followed by card ...1002
test.when: the first card ...1002 record is reached
test.then: 'Account Total' with dots and '-         75.00' is written, then a dash line

title: Page break every 20 lines by exact multiple
rule: Before each detail line, if the line counter is an exact multiple of 20, a page-total line and dash line are written, followed by the four header lines. The counter counts headers, details, account-total and page-total lines.

test.given: the line counter at 20 when the 17th detail is about to be written (4 headers + 16 details)
test.then: 'Page Total' line, dash line and 4 header lines are written first, then the detail

title: Page totals roll into the grand total
rule: Writing a page-total line adds the page total to the grand total and resets the page total to zero. The grand total is printed once, at end of file, as 'Grand Total' with dots and the amount edited +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.ZZ.

test.given: a single page with page total +84.00
test.then: the last three lines are the 'Page Total' line ending '+         84.00', a dash line, and the 'Grand Total' line ending '+         84.00'

title: End of file adds the last amount again
rule: At end of file the record area still holds the last transaction; its amount is displayed ('TRAN-AMT ' and 'WS-PAGE-TOTAL' lines on SYSOUT) and then added a second time to the page and account totals before the final page and grand totals are written. Totals are therefore overstated by the last transaction's amount.

test.given: one reported transaction of 42.00
test.then: SYSOUT shows 'TRAN-AMT 00000004200+' and 'WS-PAGE-TOTAL00000004200+', and the page and grand totals print +84.00

title: Last account's total is never printed
rule: Account totals are written only on a card-number change, and the end-of-file branch writes page and grand totals only, so the final card in the report never gets an 'Account Total' line.

test.given: two cards in the report
test.then: exactly one 'Account Total' line appears (for the first card)

title: Report SYSOUT start and end messages
rule: CBTRN03C displays 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' at start and 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' after closing its files. It sets no return code, so TRANREPT ends RC 0 even when POSTTRAN had rejects.

test.given: a posting run that ended RC 4
test.then: STEP10R ends RC 0 and SYSOUT ends with 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C'
